name: target_confberserk
description: The Berserk and Confuse turn: the default attack (Chr+0x6c6) aimed by the auto-target mask (side 0 opposite, 1 own side with the actor); an empty record when the attack id is 0 or the mask is empty.

function.signature: int confuse_berserk_turn(int user, Chr *chr, Rec *rec, int kind, int side)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: out.ret is -1 forced or -2 dropped; out.command and out.mask are the queued record (absent when nothing was queued), out.perm the actor permanent word afterwards.
